subcontractorTasks.title: Upload Additional Insured Endorsement for Ongoing Operations
subcontractorTasks.description: Your General Liability policy is missing the Additional Insured endorsement for ongoing operations (CG 2010). This endorsement is required before work can begin.

metadata.required_endorsement: CG 2010 - Additional Insured - Owners, Lessees or Contractors - Scheduled Person or Organization (Ongoing Operations)
metadata.correction_instructions: Contact your insurance broker to add the CG 2010 endorsement naming Massei Construction as Additional Insured for ongoing operations. Upload the updated certificate once received.

subcontractorTasks.title: Update Auto Liability Coverage Symbol
subcontractorTasks.description: Your Commercial Auto policy shows Symbol 7 (Specifically Described Autos), but the project requires Symbol 1 (Any Auto) coverage.

metadata.symbol_explanation: Symbol 1 provides coverage for any auto used in your business, including owned, hired, and non-owned vehicles. Symbol 7 only covers specifically listed vehicles, which may not provide adequate protection for this project.
metadata.correction_instructions: Contact your broker to update your Commercial Auto policy to Symbol 1 coverage. This will ensure all vehicles used on the project are covered.

subcontractorTasks.title: Increase Umbrella Liability Limits
subcontractorTasks.description: Your current Umbrella Liability limit of $1,000,000 does not meet the project requirement of $5,000,000.

metadata.correction_instructions: Request a quote from your broker to increase your Umbrella Liability limits to $5,000,000. Upload the updated certificate once the increase is bound.

subcontractorTasks.title: Update Umbrella Policy Description of Operations
subcontractorTasks.description: Your Umbrella policy does not explicitly state that it provides excess coverage over General Liability, Auto Liability, and Employers Liability as required.

metadata.current_language: Umbrella Liability provides excess coverage over underlying policies.
metadata.required_language: Umbrella or Excess Liability coverage provides excess limits over General Liability, Auto Liability, and Employers Liability.
metadata.correction_instructions: Request an endorsement from your broker that explicitly states the Umbrella policy provides excess coverage over GL, Auto, and Employers Liability. This language must appear on the certificate.

subcontractorTasks.title: Increase General Liability Limits to Meet Project Requirements
subcontractorTasks.description: Your current General Liability limit of $1,000,000 per occurrence does not meet the project requirement of $2,000,000 per occurrence.

metadata.correction_instructions: The uploaded certificate shows limits of $1M/$2M aggregate, but the project requires $2M per occurrence. Please request updated limits from your broker and upload a new certificate with the correct per-occurrence limit.
metadata.rejection_reason: Certificate shows $1M per occurrence instead of required $2M per occurrence.

subcontractorTasks.title: Add Waiver of Subrogation Endorsement
subcontractorTasks.description: Your General Liability policy is missing the Waiver of Subrogation endorsement. This is required for all subcontractors on this project.

metadata.required_endorsement: Waiver of Transfer of Rights of Recovery Against Others to Us - This endorsement waives the insurer's right to subrogate against the additional insured.
metadata.correction_instructions: Contact your insurance broker to add a Waiver of Subrogation endorsement to your General Liability policy. Upload the updated certificate once received.

subcontractorTasks.title: Update Auto Liability Symbol from 7 to 1
subcontractorTasks.description: Your Commercial Auto policy currently shows Symbol 7 (Specifically Described Autos). The project requires Symbol 1 (Any Auto) coverage.

metadata.symbol_explanation: Symbol 1 provides coverage for any auto used in your business operations, including owned, hired, and non-owned vehicles. Symbol 7 only covers vehicles specifically listed on your policy schedule.
metadata.correction_instructions: Contact your broker to update your Commercial Auto policy to Symbol 1. This change ensures all vehicles used on the project are covered, including rental vehicles and employee-owned vehicles used for business purposes.

subcontractorTasks.title: Add Primary and Non-Contributory Endorsement
subcontractorTasks.description: Your General Liability policy must include the Primary and Non-Contributory endorsement. This ensures your policy responds first and does not share coverage with other policies.

metadata.correction_instructions: Contact your insurance broker to add the Primary and Non-Contributory endorsement to your General Liability policy. Upload the updated certificate once received.
